system.story: Credentials, protocol, and the weight of institutional power.

description.value:
Origin: Corp-Exec. You walk into the arcology like you own a floor of it.

Credentials & Protocol

You can manufacture or leverage plausible authority (access, clearance, "I'm expected"), gaining edges to command NPCs who respect hierarchy and to negotiations framed around Higher Authority and Greed. Your commands to hired/subordinate NPCs are especially potent.

Bonus skill & contact

Corporate/Bureaucracy skill; contact: a corp insider or handler.

Fully mundane - no Veil access, no magic-erosion penalty.
